bioconda.name: bioconductor-doppelgangr
bioconda.summary: Identify likely duplicate samples from genomic or meta-data

biotools.summary: The main function is doppelgangR(), which takes as minimal input a list of ExpressionSet object, and searches all list pairs for duplicated samples.  The search is based on the genomic data (exprs(eset)), phenotype/clinical data (pData(eset)), and "smoking guns" - supposedly unique identifiers found in pData(eset).
